top_signals.title: Post-Midterm Rotation Hits Chips, Boosts China: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A stock-rotation trade fueled by the US midterm elections swept Asia, denting regional chipmakers and boosting unfavored markets from Australia to China. Sliding oil prices helped fuel gains in Southeast Asia.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
